items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: You were good friends with George Hoefer, the jazz writer. You used to correspond with him.

ctx.x: trinket, toys and things and there's a big neon sign that says, "Big Chief," and so when I was in Paris I rigged up this idea to have my picture taken in front of that Big Chief sign. It wasn't advertising my name. I think they used my name to the store owner there to put the neon sign up there "Big Chief." So I got the idea with that background "Big Chief" on it.
You were good friends with George Hoefer, the jazz writer. You used to correspond with him. There are some copies of your letters --
Oh, George Hoefer -- he passed away and also I used to correspond with Max Jones at Sinclair Traill --
